subject.title: Bug:  ignores  config and returns success on media failure

question: Should Feishu CLI media failures for paths outside the current shared local-media allowlist fail or partial-fail under the shared `tools.fs` media policy, or should OpenClaw add a Feishu-specific `channels.feishu.mediaLocalRoots` config surface?
rationale: The remaining fix changes both host file-read/upload authority and user-visible delivery-result semantics, so automation should not choose the security boundary or fallback behavior on its own.

options.title: Use shared policy and explicit failure
options.body: Keep local-media access under the shared filesystem/media policy and update Feishu to report allowlist upload failures as failure or explicit partial success.

options.title: Add Feishu-specific roots
options.body: Accept a new Feishu config surface only with schema, docs, security review, and focused upgrade tests proving the expanded host-file authority is intentional.

options.title: Document fallback as intentional
options.body: Keep fallback text delivery as success and document that failed uploads may still send a link-like text fallback.

recommendation.title: Use shared policy and explicit failure
recommendation.body: Keep local-media access under the shared filesystem/media policy and update Feishu to report allowlist upload failures as failure or explicit partial success.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses shared outbound media access, configuration policy, and channel delivery semantics; steipete has recent central history on those paths.
